source_description: Identifier to uniquely specify a patient.
interpretation_and_caution: Public pseudonymous participant key; retain as text. Repeated MSK cohorts may share patients.
Recorded source category; no additional categories or missingness inferred.

source_description: Age at which a condition or disease was first diagnosed.
interpretation_and_caution: Source metadata labels diagnosis age; exact age reference date is not supplied. Do not relabel as age at ICI start.

source_description: Indicates if person is a smoker.
interpretation_and_caution: Ever/Never only; no pack-years or smoking chronology.
Source stores as STRING; values 1-7. Treatment-line label does not identify prior regimens.
Clinical trial/Commercial context, not randomized allocation or IRB protocol ID.
Monotherapy/Combination ICI context; no drug names, doses or randomized control supplied.
Study-specific time from ICI start to progression or censoring at last scan. Do not assume standard progression-or-death endpoint; death handling cannot be resolved from this table.
0:Not Progressed is censored; 1:Progressed is the recorded event. Death is not separately identified.
YES/NO/NE study adjudication. NE patients censored before six months; retain separately, never convert to NO. This is not a cure label.

source_description: Identifier to uniquely specify a patient.
interpretation_and_caution: Public pseudonymous participant key; retain as text. Repeated MSK cohorts may share patients.
Public specimen key; do not infer timing relative to treatment from suffixes.
IMPACT341/410/468; different gene coverage and coding-region denominators. Panel is not a treatment.
LUAD/LUSC/LUNE/NSCLC; do not silently drop neuroendocrine or unspecified source cases.
Original published rate; study reports somatic nonsynonymous mutation count divided by panel coding Mb (0.98/1.06/1.22). Exact original values retained; primary replication biomarker.
Study fraction of genome with log2 copy-number gain >0.2 or loss <-0.2 relative to profiled genome; dimensionless. Not a mutational count.
Tumor PD-L1 percent, 0-100 when present; blank is missing, zero is measured zero. Current count differs from paper's stated analysis subset.
Source umbrella cancer category.
Source histologic label; preserve all four observed categories.
Matched for all samples; study used patient-matched blood normal. Not a diagnosis or outcome.
Later cBioPortal TMB field, absent from original 2018 clinical sample file and different from MUTATION_RATE in all rows. Do not mix, overwrite or treat as original published biomarker.
